to: The backlog still calls the tool by a name it no longer has

The 133 archived tasks keep the name of their own day. Renaming the tool inside a closed record makes the file assert something that was never true, which is not what TL-137 did when it translated 145 files — translating preserves a claim, renaming replaces it. The stranger's problem is answered by a section in LINEAGE.md naming both retired names and their dates, and the guard therefore covers OPEN tasks only.
